description: Relist the seller's listings on one marketplace: each comes back as a new listing, so likes and views reset, and it picks up the seller's current listing settings, such as a new description template. Pass product_ids, or all_on_channel: true for every in-stock listing there (max 500). Confirm the marketplace and count with the seller before sending confirmed: true. Accepted is not relisted: items are worked through over the next hours; follow progress at status_url. Skipped items (sold_out, not_on_channel, already_queued) are normal, do not retry them. Relisting is a paid feature, and needs a write-enabled API token.

all_on_channel.description: True to relist every in-stock listing on this marketplace (up to 500) instead of product_ids.

confirmed.description: True only after the seller approves the marketplace and how many listings will be relisted.

connection_id.description: Only for a seller with several stores on this marketplace: the store to relist on.

product_ids.description: FLUF product ids from the `fluf_id` field of list_products. Omit when all_on_channel is true.

name: relist_listings
